info.title: Analyzer address
info.description: The query parameters of the Analyzer page of the retrieval web application. A caller (a link in another tool such as pvinfo, a bookmark, a hand-typed address) needs pv alone and may add from and to; the page writes every other parameter back into its address so that the same view opens again. Serialization follows OpenAPI: a list is a repeated parameter (style form, explode true) or a comma-separated value (explode false), a per-target setting is a deepObject whose key is the PV name or the unit, a time is RFC 3339 in UTC, a duration is ISO 8601, a boolean is true or false. The page percent-encodes the brackets of a deepObject key and of a PV name; a caller may leave them raw (encodeURI does), because the appliance's Tomcat connector is set to accept a raw bracket (relaxedQueryChars), while a container without that setting answers 400. The page reads with URLSearchParams and keeps the first occurrence of a single parameter; the semantics of defaults, fallbacks and canonical writing are in the M2 register of docs/milestone-bfb0dc71.md.

retrieval.description: The retrieval web application of the appliance; the address of its Analyzer is this value followed by the path below.

get.summary: Open the Analyzer on archived PVs

pvName.description: An archived PV name, with an optional field.

unit.description: The engineering unit of a PV as the archive stores it; the empty string is no unit. The key of a per-unit setting.

time.description: RFC 3339 in UTC with up to nine fractional digits; the page keeps the digits it reads.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration of hours, minutes and seconds with at least one component; the seconds may carry up to nine fractional digits.

wholeSeconds.description: ISO 8601 duration with at least one component that is a whole number of seconds from 1 to 2147483647, the interval of a retrieval operator.

resolution.description: Raw records, or means over whole seconds.

text.description: Plain text of at most 128 code points without control characters.

finite.description: A finite decimal number; an empty value or a word is invalid, never zero.

pv.name: pv
pv.description: The PVs in series order; a repeated name keeps its first place.

from.name: from
from.description: The start of the displayed range; with to, an ordered pair, else the page shows the last hour.

to.name: to
to.description: The end of the displayed range.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: The display resolution: raw records or means over this many seconds; absent, the page chooses about 700 means over the displayed range.

tz.name: tz
tz.description: The zone of the labels: browser, UTC or an IANA zone the page offers.

profile.name: profile
profile.description: The display profile the page offers.

selectedFrom.name: selectedFrom
selectedFrom.description: The start of the selected range, the dataset of the Summary and the target of Reset; with selectedTo, an ordered pair; absent, the displayed range.

selectedTo.name: selectedTo
selectedTo.description: The end of the selected range.

sample.name: sample
sample.description: The resolution of the selected dataset, resolved once when the selection is made; absent, resolved from interval over the selected range.

minMax.name: minMax
minMax.description: The band between the min and the max of the display means; not available for raw records.

split.name: split
split.description: One plot, or one panel per unit sharing the time axis.

hide.name: hide
hide.description: The PVs whose line is hidden; they keep their data and their Summary rows.

wheel.name: wheel
wheel.description: Ctrl+wheel zoom around the pointer; off, the wheel scrolls the page.

nav.name: nav
nav.description: The axes that Pan, Box zoom and the wheel move.

navUnit.name: navUnit
navUnit.description: The unit whose axis a y or xy navigation targets; required for those, else nav falls back to x.

cursor1.name: cursor1
cursor1.description: The time of the first reference cursor.

cursor2.name: cursor2
cursor2.description: The time of the second reference cursor.

pin.name: pin
pin.description: A pinned observation as PV@time, the time of the observation in RFC 3339 with its nanoseconds. The page restores the value from the observation of the display dataset at exactly that time; without one the pin is listed as unavailable.

legendStats.name: legendStats
legendStats.description: The columns of the legend table, in order.

tooltip.name: tooltip
tooltip.description: Every visible line, or the nearest line only.

tooltipSort.name: tooltipSort
tooltipSort.description: The order of the tooltip rows.

grid.name: grid
grid.description: The grid lines behind the data.

endLabels.name: endLabels
endLabels.description: The name of each visible line at its last visible observation.

width.name: width
width.description: The line width in pixels of a PV, as width[PV]=3; absent, the profile's width.

dash.name: dash
dash.description: The dash pattern of a PV's line; absent, the profile's pattern.

gap.name: gap
gap.description: The longest duration two samples of a PV stay connected; a recorded disconnect always breaks the line.

fill.name: fill
fill.description: The other selected PV of the same unit the area between the two lines is filled to.

decimals.name: decimals
decimals.description: The decimal places shown for a PV's values; absent, the magnitude decides.

name.name: name
name.description: The display name of a PV; the PV name stays the identity in Data and Export.

axisScale.name: axisScale
axisScale.description: The scale of a unit's axis, as axisScale[mA]=log; absent, the yscale of the chart.

axisSymlog.name: axisSymlog
axisSymlog.description: The linear-region constant of a unit's symmetric log scale.

axisMin.name: axisMin
axisMin.description: With axisMax of the same unit, a fixed range (policy fixed); one without the other is dropped.

axisMax.name: axisMax
axisMax.description: The upper bound of a fixed range, above axisMin.

axisSoftMin.name: axisSoftMin
axisSoftMin.description: A suggested lower bound the automatic range widens to (policy soft); either or both soft bounds may be given, the min below the max.

axisSoftMax.name: axisSoftMax
axisSoftMax.description: A suggested upper bound the automatic range widens to.

axisZero.name: axisZero
axisZero.description: Zero in the middle of an automatic or soft linear or symmetric log axis.

axisPrefix.name: axisPrefix
axisPrefix.description: SI prefixes on the values of a unit, the prefix written before the unit; absent, none.

axisLabel.name: axisLabel
axisLabel.description: The label of a unit's axis, as axisLabel[mA]=Beam current; axisLabel[]=Value names the axis of the PVs without a unit.

export.name: export
export.description: The choices of the Export tab, as export[source]=interpolated&export[step]=PT1.5S; they restore the form and never run a product. The step defaults to one second and the gap to none; a custom range needs both from and to, else the shown range is used with a note.

distribution.name: distribution
distribution.description: The options of the Distribution tab (phase C), as distribution[view]=box&distribution[bins]=50: the signal (one of the pv values; the first by default), the view, the bin rule and the bin count it uses, the normalization, the kernel density estimate, the number of standard deviations of the values beyond and the model of the histogram fit (phase D; a fit runs from its button). A field that is not valid keeps its default, and a default is not written.

trend.name: trend
trend.description: The Trend tools (phase C), as trend[fit]=true&trend[threshold]=12: the signal (the first pv by default), the rate of change, the slow trend, the limits of the PV, the threshold in the unit of the signal (none by default) and the side of it that counts as beyond. A field that is not valid keeps its default, and a default is not written.

compare.name: compare
compare.description: The options of the Compare tab (phase C), as compare[mode]=signals&compare[b]=SR:BEAM:CURRENT: two ranges of one signal or two signals, signal A (the first pv by default) and signal B (the first other pv by default), the method of the test, and range B as an ordered pair of times, written only when the user set it (else the page proposes the range of the duration of A that ends where A starts). The options restore the form; the comparison runs from its button.

spectrum.name: spectrum
spectrum.description: The options of the Spectrum tab (phase C), as spectrum[view]=spectrogram&spectrum[window]=blackman: the signal (the first pv by default), the view, the resampling interval in seconds (the median spacing of the samples by default), the gap policy, the window, the output of the spectrum view, its logarithmic value axis, the zero padding, and the segment length and overlap of the spectrogram. A field that is not valid keeps its default, and a default is not written.

correlation.name: correlation
correlation.description: The options of the Correlation tab (phase D), as correlation[x]=SR:GEN:SINE&correlation[view]=profile: signal X (the first pv by default) and signal Y (the first other pv by default), the view, the point size and transparency, colour by time, the lags of the cross-correlation, the rectangle selection, and the model and range of the fit panel. A fit runs from its button; the start values, fixed parameters and bounds restore from the form only. A field that is not valid keeps its default, and a default is not written.

yscale.name: yscale
yscale.description: The scale of every axis without its own axisScale (phase A).

avg.name: avg
avg.description: The running average over the shared window (phase A; 1 for on).

band.name: band
band.description: The standard deviation band over the shared window (phase A; 1 for on).

window.name: window
window.description: The shared sample window of the running average and the band (phase A).

yproj.name: yproj
yproj.description: The Y projection (phase A; 1 for on).

yrange.name: yrange
yrange.description: A fixed range as unit:low:high (phase A; none for no unit); read when the unit has no axisMin and axisMax, the last valid entry of a unit winning; written no more.
